decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Matching materials</u>&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Boundary Treatment&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The boundary treatments as shown on plans shall be completed before the development hereby approved is occupied and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Cycle Storage&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to the first occupation of development, details of secure and sheltered cycle stores (including dimensions, elevations and external materials) to be located on site with a minimum of 2 long stay cycle parking spaces for each of the residential dwellings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Refuse Storage</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to occupation of the dwellings, details of the waste storage area shall be submitted and approved by the local planning authority. The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Pipe Protection</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development hereby permitted shall not commence until a scheme for the protection of the piped watercourse has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include a structural survey by CCTV and trial holes to assess the construction, position, condition, and expected life of the culvert; proposal of an agreed method of repair or replacement if required; full details demonstrating that the new structure does not impart any load on the culvert or destabilise it in any way; details of any necessary build over or adjacent to the culvert; details of access for future repairs, blockage clearance, maintenance, and future condition surveys.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The applicant can contact the Harrow Infrastructure Team for further information regarding this matter.</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Fire Safety&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Prior to occupation a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Landscaping</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the forecourt of the site. Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Timing&nbsp;&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><br></span>The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Approved Drawing and Documents&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out, completed and retained in accordance with the following approved plans and document Schedule of application documents:&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, Planning Statement-Nov. 2025 (Capital Planners &amp; Architects), Site Location Plan, Flood Risk Assessment-Nov. 2025 (Capital Planners &amp; Architects), Fire Safety Statement-Nov. 2025 (Capital Planners &amp; Architects).&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>Landscaping Management&nbsp;</u></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.&nbsp;</span></p><div><br></div>
description: Conversion of single dwelling to 2 x 3 bed flats  with private amenity space, associated car parking, refuse and cycle storage, Replace garage door with window and door in front elevation, Single storey rear extension, External alterations (Demolition of ground floor rear bay window and outbuilding to rear)
